description: Async replication (repair), the replication coordinator, and replica movement operations.

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_scheduler_workers_active` (gauge). Number of scheduler worker goroutines currently executing a hashbeat cycle
panels.title: Workers active

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_scheduler_workers_live` (gauge). Number of live scheduler worker goroutines (spawned but not yet exited).
panels.title: Workers live

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_scheduler_worker_pool_size` (gauge). Current target size of the scheduler worker pool.
panels.title: Worker pool size

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_scheduler_queue_depth` (gauge). Number of shards waiting in the scheduler heap (not in-flight).
panels.title: Queue depth

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_scheduler_shards_registered` (gauge). Number of shards currently registered with the async replication scheduler
panels.title: Shards registered

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_reconcile_failures_total` (counter). Number of indices that failed to reconcile async replication with the global AsyncReplicationDisabled flag.
panels.title: Reconcile failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_target_skip_count` (counter). Count of async replication targets skipped as retry-later, by reason **May be empty:** Only when a peer answers 'retry later': it is in maintenance mode (MAINTENANCE_NODES), its shard is unloaded or has async replication disabled, or it is still booting.
panels.title: Targets skipped /s by reason

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_local_deletions_total` (counter). Total local object deletions applied due to remote-deleted verdicts or deletion-conflict responses during async replication.
panels.title: Local deletions /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_hashtree_init_count` (counter). Count of async replication hashtree initializations
panels.title: Hashtree inits /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_hashtree_init_running` (gauge). Number of currently running hashtree initializations
panels.title: Hashtree inits running

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_hashtree_init_failure_count` (counter). Count of async replication hashtree initialization failures
panels.title: Hashtree init failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_hashtree_init_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration of hashtree initialization in seconds
panels.title: Hashtree init duration

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_rebuild_total` (counter). Number of completed hashtree rebuilds (a shard picked up a changed hashtree height).
panels.title: Rebuilds /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_rebuild_failures_total` (counter). Number of failed hashtree rebuild attempts; a growing rate means shards are out of the repair mesh while retrying.
panels.title: Rebuild failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_rebuild_yields_total` (counter). Rebuild attempts that stood down for a schema apply, teardown, transfer halt, or drain timeout; spinning with rebuild_total flat means a rebuild is starved.
panels.title: Rebuild yields /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_iteration_count` (counter). Count of async replication comparison iterations
panels.title: Iterations /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_iteration_failure_count` (counter). Count of async replication iteration failures
panels.title: Iteration failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_iteration_running` (gauge). Number of currently running async replication iterations
panels.title: Iterations running

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_iteration_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration of async replication comparison iterations in seconds
panels.title: Iteration duration

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_hashtree_diff_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration of async replication hashtree diff computation in seconds
panels.title: Hashtree diff duration

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_object_digests_diff_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration of async replication object digests diff computation in seconds
panels.title: Object digests diff duration

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_objects_diff_total` (counter). Total objects found in diff per hashbeat cycle (queued for propagation or locally deleted before propagation).
panels.title: Objects found different /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_root_prefilter_skips_total` (counter). Shard cycles short-circuited as in-sync by the batched hashtree-root pre-filter.
panels.title: Root prefilter skips /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_root_prefilter_batch_size` (histogram). Number of shards compared in one batched hashtree-root pre-filter RPC group.
panels.title: Root prefilter batch size

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_root_compare_rpc_total` (counter). Batched hashtree-root compare RPCs by outcome.
panels.title: Root compare RPCs /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_propagation_count` (counter). Count of async replication propagation executions
panels.title: Propagations /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_propagation_failure_count` (counter). Count of async replication propagation failures
panels.title: Propagation failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_propagation_object_count` (counter). Count of objects propagated by async replication
panels.title: Objects propagated /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_replication_propagation_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration of async replication propagation in seconds
panels.title: Propagation duration

panels.description: `weaviate_async_checkpoint_active` (gauge). Shards on this node currently holding an active checkpoint. Replacements don't change the count.
panels.title: Active checkpoints

panels.description: `weaviate_async_checkpoint_create_total` (counter). Successful local async-checkpoint creations (includes replacements).
panels.title: Created /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_checkpoint_create_failure_total` (counter). Failed CreateAsyncCheckpoint calls (stale createdAt + async-rep-not-active).
panels.title: Create failures /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_checkpoint_delete_total` (counter). Explicit DeleteAsyncCheckpoint calls that cleared an active checkpoint (stop/disable clears excluded).
panels.title: Deleted /s

panels.description: `weaviate_async_checkpoint_lifetime_seconds` (histogram). Time a checkpoint stayed active before being cleared (explicit delete, replacement, or stop/disable).
panels.title: Checkpoint lifetime

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_coordinator_writes_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration in seconds of write operations to replicas
panels.title: Replicated write latency

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_coordinator_reads_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration in seconds of read operations from replicas
panels.title: Replicated read latency

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_read_repair_duration_seconds` (histogram). Duration in seconds of read repair operations
panels.title: Read repair duration

panels.title: Engine running

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_engine_producer_running_status` (gauge). The replication engine producer running status (0: not running, 1: running)
panels.title: Producer running

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_engine_consumer_running_status` (gauge). The replication engine consumer running status (0: not running, 1: running)
panels.title: Consumer running

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_pending_operations` (gauge). Number of replication operations pending processing
panels.title: Pending operations

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_ongoing_operations` (gauge). Number of replication operations currently in progress
panels.title: Ongoing operations

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_operation_fsm_ops_by_state` (gauge). Current number of replication operations in each state of the FSM lifecycle
panels.title: Operations by state

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_complete_operations` (counter). Number of successfully completed replication operations
panels.title: Completed /s

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_failed_operations` (counter). Number of failed replication operations
panels.title: Failed /s

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_cancelled_operations` (counter). Number of cancelled replication operations
panels.title: Cancelled /s

panels.description: `weaviate_replication_operation_cleanup_deleted_total` (counter). Total number of stale replication operations removed by the cleanup sweep
panels.title: Cleanup deleted /s

panels.title: Cleanup failures /s
